name: Nanako Takagi
source: Nanako is the company's first prodigy before Toku came along. A beautiful and talented finance graduate, she is an important asset to the company, and her work often overlaps with Toku. Initially on friendly terms, they somehow forged a rivalry with each other somewhere along the way. Beneath her tough professional exterior, Nanako is a caring friend with high emotional awareness.
